notes: Read focused pages extracted from every SET item harmonization.sources.pdfPages; did not audit the full book. Visually inspected PDF page 107 to confirm the intersection, three-set and subset diagrams and symbols.

These pages support common-element intersection, inclusive union, complements within the specified universal set, brackets first, and separate-region counting. Provided scenario values remain local data; they are not textbook game rules.
The three-group worked example on PDF page 123 separates inclusive pairwise counts from the all-three count; the proposed SET-038 Hint/More Hint follows that route.
Read focused cited pages for BM wording; visually inspected PDF page 119 to verify pelengkap, set semesta and gabungan operasi set. No whole-book audit is claimed.

Retained KSSM terms unsur, set kosong, persilangan, kesatuan, pelengkap, set semesta, unsur sepunya and gambar rajah Venn. Used short membership and counting instructions instead of unnecessary advanced law names.
SET-033 and SET-035 only-group calculations use the given overlap once for each relevant only-group. SET-034 exactly-two values explicitly exclude the all-three group.

Read DSKP PDF pages 62–63, printed pages 48–49; visually inspected PDF page 62. Standards 4.1.1–4.1.3 cover intersection/complement/problems, 4.2.1–4.2.3 union/complement/problems, and 4.3.1–4.3.3 combined operations/complements/problems.

The DSKP asks for descriptions, symbolic/list representations and Venn diagrams with real situations. This review covers these 40 authored items, not complete DSKP mastery. SET-027 remains enrichment rather than a newly required named law.
